notes: Probe anti-corrosion: pulse-power the GP14 conductivity probe (pull-up only ~1ms per read, idle high-Z) instead of biasing it the whole wake; skip energising it entirely when PROBE_SENSOR_ENABLED is false (Stage 7 + offline now gated, offline falls back to ultrasonic cutoff). New 'probe_test' ntfy command force-reads the probe (5 pulse reads) and replies with wet/dry tally + water level for cross-check; 'test' mode now reports a probe wet/dry summary too.
